Lina (People Ops): Heads-up: we're launching three People Ops updates today that affect PTO, travel approvals, and a small emergency stipend pilot. Short summary: 1) PTO rollover cap increases to 10 days (effective end of fiscal year); 2) two "wellness flex" days will be added as uncapped, manager-approved days for mental health/wellness; 3) Emergency Travel Stipend pilot: up to $500 one-time for urgent caregiver travel (applies to full-time employees, requests triaged by People Ops). Full policy + request forms here: https://intranet.redwood/people/pto-travel-apr2026 — please skim if this touches you. :sparkles:

Marco (People Ops): Quick note on travel approvals 1) Routine work travel still follows the Travel Portal approvals. 2) For travel to high-risk locations or cross-border relocations, please submit at least 15 business days before departure so we can clear visas and insurance. 3) If you already have bookings, DM People Ops w/ receipts & manager approval and we will reconcile.

Jordan (Eng Manager): For the EoFY rollover: does the extra 10 days stack with manager discretionary carryover? I have folks who already agreed with me to take time in Q4.

Lina (People Ops): Good Q. The new cap replaces the previous cap; it will be applied at EoFY during rollover calculations. Manager-approved exceptions for planned time (approved before policy publish) will be honored. If you have team members with approved plans, email Marco and we'll flag them.

Priya (Finance): About the stipend pilot: we'll process the $500 as a special reimbursement. Please attach travel documentation and a short explanation on the stipend form. Payments will follow standard payroll/reimbursement cycles (expect ~2 pay cycles). If you need expedited processing for time-sensitive reimbursements, mark "urgent" and cc Priya.

Nora (HR): Wellness flex days are confidential; managers can approve without medical details. We encourage teams to normalize using them. They do not count against performance reviews or require doctor notes.

Jordan (Eng Manager): Will contractors / temps be eligible for the wellness flex days or the stipend?

Marco (People Ops): Contractors are not eligible for paid wellness flex days or the stipend. Short-term contractors can request unpaid leave and we'll work with managers on coverage. We'll publish a contractor-specific FAQ later today.

TravelAssistantBot: Travel portal update deployed: added "high-risk" country flag and a new upload field for visa docs. Commands: `/travel status` `/travel upload <txid>` 1. Help: https://intranet.redwood/travelbot-help

Priya (Finance): One operational note 1) If travel is booked on a personal card but eligible for company reimbursement, attach the booking receipt within 30 days. 2) Stipend requests without receipts will be evaluated case-by-case and may require follow-up.

Lina (People Ops): Office hours tomorrow 9am PT for any questions and case reviews. If you need an exception (pre-booked travel, pre-approved PTO that overlaps year-end), bring the approval evidence to the session or email us and we'll triage.

Jordan (Eng Manager): Thanks 1 appreciated. I'll forward to my team and flag folks with pre-approved plans.

Marco (People Ops): Final reminder: updated Code of Conduct applies at vendor events and offsite socials; vendors must be registered 5 business days in advance and any external swag distribution needs sign-off. Link in the policy page.

Lina (People Ops): Thanks all 1 we'll pin the policy doc in People Ops updates after office hours. :pushpin:
